case.summary: Case SEN-005 was opened following a Sentinel sweep on card C02716-K2 for customer C02716 after detecting structured online purchases just under the $500 threshold. Graph analysis confirmed a fraud verdict with a 0.90 probability across an episode of 5 transactions totaling $2,499.89. The investigation noted that transaction 3581257 used a new device profile Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1024x768. Because the customer has 19 earlier confirmed fraud cases, policy R10 is met and recommended actions include BLOCK_ALL_CARDS, CREATE_CASE, and FILE_REPORT.

sar.narrative: Customer C02716 holding card C02716-K2 was identified in a fraud investigation involving suspicious online activity. A series of 5 transactions totaling $2,499.89 were executed across the episode spanning from 2016-12-28 12:36:04 to 2016-12-28 13:36:15. The activity occurred online across regional channels utilizing a device profile marked as new for the account. The transactions were structured specifically to stay just under the $500 authorization threshold to evade standard automated triggers. This behavior is highly suspicious due to the rapid velocity, structuring tactics, and the customer's extensive history of prior confirmed fraud cases. No connected cards were flagged in this specific incident. Recommended actions include blocking all customer cards, creating a formal case, and filing a regulatory report.
